claims.statement: The edge-evidence platform preserves immutable local evidence and records canonical local authority in SQLite plus the filesystem.
Processor and replication workers are deterministic bounded executables, not autonomous schedulers or evidence authorities.
Read-only agent and HTTP surfaces do not gain worker, SQLite, spool, credential, deployment, publication, or persistent-evidence authority.

This product runs separately installed generated workers and proves a verified synthetic processor report is replicated byte-for-byte into a deterministic local target with independent readback and exact replay no-op behavior.

The canonical runtime container completed one owner-authorized private Cloud Run deployment and authenticated synthetic smoke proof in a disposable environment; the repository remains credential-free and is not deployment authority.
The private hosted provider smoke evidence is not physical NAS, production availability, performance, fleet, durability, or persistent evidence-authority proof.

A separate reference-platform evidence track has an accepted zero-mutation GKE external-exposure observation proving the reviewed synthetic three-service workload and bounded same-origin HTTP journey under a stable provider state; private provider coordinates and retained evidence are not published here.

The accepted GKE observation is not proof of final stable-address ownership, DNS, TLS/HTTPS, a permanent public endpoint, production availability, performance, scale, physical evidence integration, or persistent hosted evidence authority.

prohibited: production-grade cloud or general availability claims
performance, scale, uptime, SLO, or fleet qualification
independent provider, cleanup, IAM, or scheduler operations outside reviewed controls
final DNS, TLS/HTTPS, stable-address ownership, or permanent public endpoint claims
publication of private topology, provider coordinates, credentials, Terraform state, or retained evidence payloads
